name: Direct evidence match
condition: candidate drug matches a documented drug-gene relationship

name: Mechanistic precedent
condition: candidate mechanism and selected gene/variant match an established pharmacogenomic relationship, but candidate drug is not documented
effect: label result as MECHANISTIC_PRECEDENT; do not present as proven clinical risk

name: Population relevance
condition: relevant variant/phenotype has a documented population frequency observation

name: Representation gap
condition: population is relevant to a signal but not included in planned trial regions
effect: increase screening priority and display a representation-gap warning

name: Evidence ceiling
effect: do not allow final priority to exceed Moderate without stronger evidence

name: Unknown knowledge
condition: no supported relationship exists for the selected pathway/variant
effect: return INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE instead of inventing a risk

name: Frequency is not probability
condition: population frequency is used in scoring
effect: never label frequency as probability of adverse drug reaction
